test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

They all felt that the movie was truly __captivating__ and unforgettable.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Repugnant)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Captivating"** means something that holds attention or fascination; it is enchanting and delightful. (मोहक)
 
 
• **Example:** The captivating beauty of the sunset left everyone speechless.
 
 
 
• **"Repugnant"** refers to something that is offensive, distasteful, or repulsive; it creates a sense of strong dislike or disgust. (घृणास्पद)
 
 
• **Example:** The repugnant smell from the garbage made it impossible to stay in the room.
 
 
 
• Since "repugnant" is the direct antonym of "captivating," it is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Repugnant)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tantalising** (ललचाने वाला): Something that provokes interest or desire but remains out of reach.
 
 
• **Example:** The tantalising aroma of freshly baked bread made me crave a slice.
 
 
 
• **Relatable** (संबंधित): Something that can be identified with or understood easily.
 
 
• **Example:** The relatable characters in the story made it more enjoyable for the audience.
 
 
 
• **Charismatic** (आकर्षक): Having a compelling charm or appeal that inspires others.
 
 
• **Example:** The charismatic leader was able to rally the support of thousands of people.
 
 

14c:T8e6,

The correct answer is option 3.<
